bead.title: Serve one queue as one fjord topic
bead.description:
PROBLEM: Stock Kafka clients need an ordered read path for one queue's change log through embedded fjord.
ROOT CAUSE: `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-008-queue-history-change-records.md:138` through `docs/helix/02-design/technical-designs/TD-008-queue-history-change-records.md:154` require a Kafka-protocol consumer surface with one single-partition topic per queue, but `crates/pqueue-server/src/lib.rs:156` through `crates/pqueue-server/src/lib.rs:205` only materialize the fjord primitives and `crates/pqueue-engine/src/compose.rs:918` through `crates/pqueue-engine/src/compose.rs:951` still emit a generic tail without any Kafka topic/partition routing seam.
PROPOSED FIX: Add tenant-prefixed topic naming and one-partition routing for each `(tenant_id, queue_id)` stream, then expose the ordered fetch path so a stock Kafka client sees `CommandPosition` order.
NON-SCOPE: Dependency pinning, ACL scoping, and consumer-group ownership are handled by sibling beads.
bead.acceptance:
1. `TestKafkaChangeLogConsumesInCommandPositionOrder` proves a stock Kafka client reads one queue's change records in order.
2. `TestKafkaTopicMapsOneQueueToOnePartition` proves each `(tenant_id, queue_id)` stream lands on exactly one partition.
3. `go test ./... -run 'TestKafkaChangeLogConsumesInCommandPositionOrder|TestKafkaTopicMapsOneQueueToOnePartition'`
4. `lefthook run pre-commit`
5. `lefthook run pre-push`
